name: Mabuta Tojireba Soko ni...
source:
There are girls in this world with physical disabilities. They live lives full of hardship. Main character meets such a girl and gradually changes from life for himself towards life for another one.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这个世界上存在着身体残疾的女孩。他们的生活充满艰辛。主角遇到了这样一个女孩，并逐渐从为自己而活转向为他人而活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
